Effect classes: a step is a new leg, beat, gate check, session or required action an agent session performs; a rule is an instruction agents must follow or a code-enforced gate condition; a wake is a new occasion that wakes or resumes a session. A repair that makes an already-designed path work is 'neither'; a change to what the design wakes on is a wake. Code reapers and runner automation are not steps (they are not something a session does).
